curated.instructions: none found for 952; omr/instructions/851-1/ (scans of the 1977 851 Tractor, the same model as far as the pictures show: the tractor is pages 1-12, alternate models after) used in its place

functions.does: The steering wheel turns the front wheels: its column bends through a universal joint down to an 8 tooth gear on a rack plate, which swings both front wheels the same way on their turntables.

The big rear wheels drive the power take-off: a crown gear on the right half axle turns an 8 tooth gear on a short shaft running back, so the crown gear on its end, behind the tractor, turns three times as fast as the wheels.
Pushed along, the front wheels roll freely, and the hitch and its lever stay where they were set.

The lever on the right beside the seat raises and lowers the hitch: a short link from it swings the hitch's arms on the rear half axles, and the harrow, hung on the cross axle at the arms' ends and held upright by a top link pivoting behind the seat, rises and falls with them.
functions.source: book (851): steps 9, 18 and 30-31 (lever, link and top link), step 33 (the harrow hung on them)

functions.does: Lowered by the lever until it rests on its two small wheels, the harrow's top 40 tooth gear meets the power take-off's crown gear, so as the tractor drives, its three tine rotors spin.
functions.source: inferred: where the gears sit when lowered (book (851) step 33 and the photo on page 12 show the harrow on the hitch, but no arrows); unsure which way the lever goes to lower it
functions.note: checked by tests/sets/952-tractor.test.ts, which lowers it the -1.39 way; KineBrick meshes the gears only once it works the mechanism out afresh at the lowered pose

functions.does: Inside the harrow, the top 40 tooth gear drives the middle rotor's 8 tooth gear five times as fast, and the middle rotor's 40 tooth gear turns the two outer rotors the other way at the same speed.
functions.source: book (851): step 33, sub-steps 4-7 and the inset

functions.does: The harrow's two small wheels roll freely.
